findings_and_reconciliations.trace: Current body_local returns None if the requested bone is missing; body_lateral_range filters those missing observations out and returns zero if none remain. For an applicable straight run, sway gate compares chest/head range to positive limits, so missing every observation of a required bone can satisfy that local range comparison as zero; partial missing frames can also leave a range based only on the remaining observations. P17 returns Unavailable(MissingBone) on the first missing frame and when_applicable treats Unavailable as false, while no matching scenario remains NotApplicable.
findings_and_reconciliations.conditions: Requires a selected run scenario with absent chest or head in at least one captured frame (and the other side/other comparisons satisfying their own gates). Actual rig population and full capture admission may prevent or separately reject the case. No missing bone, whole report success or runtime behavior was observed; finite-transform check only examines present bones, but other report gates remain independently material.
findings_and_reconciliations.future_repair_direction: Reconcile required-bone/cohort authority and distinguish absent or partial observations from a measured zero range in the applicable sway gate.
